consumer: An ordinary combat account (HP 75 fixture near Ardougne) runs scripts/druid-meats.ts <account>. For each Druidic Ritual meat the account does not own (raw beef 2132, raw rat meat 2134, raw bear meat 2136, raw chicken 2138), it walks to a safe spawn, kills one target, picks up the meat and banks it. Saved state shows all four meats banked, unrelated assets kept, life kept and a confirmed logout. A rerun with all four meats owned refuses before travel.
